title: "Kaka Mala Vachva!" 😱 Shaniwar Wada Ki Raat Ki Cheekh #shorts
description:
Pune ke Shaniwar Wada mein, kehte hain, aaj bhi poornima ki raat ek cheekh goonjti hai: "Kaka mala vachva!" 😱
Sirf 17 saal ke Peshwa Narayanrao… ek chitthi… aur ek akshar jo badal diya gaya — "dhara" (pakdo) se "maara" (maaro)!

Aapko kya lagta hai — SACH ya VAHAM? 👇 Comment mein batao!

📜 Itihaas: Shaniwar Wada ki neev 1730 mein Bajirao Peshwa ne rakhi thi. 30 August 1773 ko yahan Peshwa Narayanrao ki hatya hui. 1828 mein lagi aag 7 din tak jalti rahi, aur wajah aaj tak pata nahi.
👻 Chitthi mein akshar badalne aur raat ki cheekh ki baatein lok-kathayein (folklore) hain.
